reasons.ENGINEERING_UI_COMPLETE: This means the engineering UI shell is complete; it does not mean all-city real maps, a validated PLATEAU connection, model integration, or administrative validation are complete.
reasons.ENGINEERING_UI_SHELL_COMPLETE: The reviewed 2D shell is implemented with synthetic SVG schematics and explicit evidence-state labels.
reasons.TWO_D_IMPLEMENTATION: Synthetic SVG schematics remain the default for all cities; Kiyomizu alone offers an explicit opt-in MapLibre view of the source-traceable CANDIDATE graph.
reasons.MAPLIBRE_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTED: MapLibre GL JS is implemented and exact-pinned in the viewer runtime.
reasons.MAPLIBRE_CONNECTED: True only for the explicit Kiyomizu real-coordinate CANDIDATE viewer layer; it is not an all-city or model-pipeline connection.
reasons.MAPLIBRE_CONNECTED_SCOPE: The true value is limited to KIYOMIZU_EXPLICIT_OPT_IN_CANDIDATE_ONLY.
reasons.ALL_THREE_CITIES_MAPLIBRE_CONNECTED: Arashiyama and Fujisawa remain synthetic fallbacks.
reasons.KIYOMIZU_REAL_2D_ARTIFACT_CONNECTED_IN_V: The hash-bound Kiyomizu VGI CANDIDATE artifact is available through explicit viewer opt-in.
reasons.CESIUM_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTED: Cesium is exact-pinned, lazy-loaded, and exercised through mocked success/failure gates.
reasons.CESIUM_CONNECTED: False means no validated real PLATEAU tileset is statically connected as a product capability.
reasons.PLATEAU_3D_CONNECTED: The real PLATEAU tileset remains unvalidated and unconnected; session root-load behavior is not a capability promotion.
reasons.THREE_D_IMPLEMENTATION: The runtime and mocked gate exist, but a validated real tileset connection does not.
reasons.REAL_MAP_COMPLETE: Kiyomizu has a scoped candidate viewer connection, but no city has a complete validated real map and the three-city product is incomplete.
reasons.KIYOMIZU_REAL_ARTIFACT_CAPABILITY: Kiyomizu has a hash-bound source-traceable VGI corridor artifact and an explicit candidate-only viewer connection; it is not a model connection.
reasons.KIYOMIZU_CANDIDATE_GRAPH_AVAILABLE: Kiyomizu has a 21-node/19-edge candidate graph with two components and route continuity NOT_ESTABLISHED.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_ARTIFACTS_AVAILABLE: PARTIAL means Kiyomizu only; Arashiyama and Fujisawa real artifacts are not integrated in this reviewed checkpoint.
reasons.ALL_THREE_CITIES_REAL_GEOMETRY: The reviewed checkpoint does not contain approved real geometry for all three cities.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED: True only for the Kiyomizu CANDIDATE viewer layer; it does not describe the model pipeline or all cities.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED_SCOPE: The broad legacy flag is disambiguated as KIYOMIZU_CANDIDATE_VIEWER_ONLY_NOT_MODEL_PIPELINE.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED_TO_VIEWER: Kiyomizu CANDIDATE geometry is connected to the viewer through explicit opt-in.
reasons.REAL_GEOMETRY_CONNECTED_TO_VIEWER_SCOPE: The true value is limited to KIYOMIZU_CANDIDATE_ONLY.
reasons.MODEL_CONNECTED: Candidate city-pack rows do not enter a real hazard/profile/model pipeline; M6 remains NOT_COMPUTED.
reasons.M7_CONNECTED_TO_REAL_EDGES: M7 core exists but no reviewed real/CANDIDATE edge has the required measured inputs.
reasons.KPI_CONNECTED: Demand, capacity, verified entrances, and operation evidence remain insufficient; KPI values stay reasoned null.
reasons.ADMIN_VALIDATED: Current facilities, entrances, capacities, operations, field evidence, and authority review are incomplete.
reasons.DEMO_COMPLETE: The V4 definition requires at least one real source-traceable UI geometry layer in every city.
reasons.PUBLIC_RELEASE_READY: Legal, data, safety, attribution, administrative, and human merge gates remain open.

three_dimensional_fallback: A 3D load, tile, render, or timeout failure returns to the current 2D layer and preserves its URL state.
